description: Released Fearless Wallet extension builds the upgrade E2E runs (scripts/upgrade-e2e/build-legacy.mjs). Each is built from its own source commit and lockfile. `commit` is resolved with git rev-parse and must name exactly `sha`.

builds.note: origin/stage: the 3.0.5 keyring and storage code without the phrase upload the Web Store package (129807f0) carries. Never build or run 129807f0.

The final 3.0.6 source: the published 3.0.5 minus the phrase upload, with AUDIT-01, AUDIT-02 (TON version 2/3 storage) and the availability fixes (HOTFIX-3.0.6). The Web Store rollback target; R1 rolls back to it.
The first release with a master password (@subwallet/ui-keyring 0.1.7).
The last release with per-account passwords (@polkadot/ui-keyring 3.5.1).
Per-account passwords, before the multi-ecosystem account meta.

@soramitsu/soramitsu-js-ui 1.0.46 existed only on the retired nexus.iroha.tech registry. The popup's UI kit is replaced by an empty stub (scripts/upgrade-e2e/stubs/soramitsu-js-ui), so the lockfile changes for that one package and the install runs without --immutable. The service worker, which owns the keyring and storage, is built from the release's own lockfile; the popup is not used.
